prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG LOW-RES PIXEL ART character review board, plain uniform medium grey opaque background. Each row has the SAME adult character in FRONT-LEFT and BACK-RIGHT oblique full-body views. Different rows are different people, isolated without interacting. Compact stocky 40-logical-pixel-like game sprite proportions, visibly chunky square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, restrained earthy wool/leather colors, very simple faces and folds, no painterly shading or smooth gradients. Match the previously viewed character reference in clarity but use coarser pixels. All clothing, hair, exact age and unconfirmed gender choices are NONCANONICAL appearance proposals. No labels, text, numbers, borders, insignia, modern medical symbols, modern clothes, magic, scenario or quest resolution. No implied payment, agreement, forced movement, political endorsement or relationship reconciliation. Exact grid/palette/pivots/runtime remain unverified.  Clothes should use medieval simple round-neck or tie-neck wool cuts, NOT modern lapels, tailored suit coats or collared shirts. THREE rows TWO columns. TOP HURE adult woman relative of a patient owed winter wool, proposed mature woman with chestnut hair and cream scarf, muted purple-brown dress and thick grey shawl, holding only a small knotted plain cord as evidence of promised wool, no delivered wool bundle or invented medical details. MIDDLE ONDO adult man ordinary garment fitness examiner, salt-brown cropped hair and small beard, faded olive round-neck tunic with tan working apron, holding a short plain wooden cloth gauge and tiny folded undecorated wool sample, no medical role or grand certificate. BOTTOM YUR young ADULT male shepherd, dark tousled hair, plain brown short wool mantle over ochre tunic, trousers and muddy boots, small simple shepherd crook held low, reserved ambitious posture. No sheep gift, trade completed, family medical history shown or whole-village sales authority.
